function.name: shell
function.arguments:
{"command": "cd /home/rimuru/Projects/Code/for_fun/TeamAgents/review/eval/r2-p6/runs/2026-09-28-r7-formal/work/twelve-deliverables.B.2
LOG=/tmp/acceptance.log; : > "$LOG"
fail=0
for u in csvfix rules ledger schedule intervals flags measure slugify ranges; do
  out=$( cd "units/$u" && python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 ); rc=$?
  echo "[$u] rc=$rc :: $(echo "$out" | tail -1)" | tee -a "$LOG"
  [ $rc -ne 0 ] && fail=1
done
out=$( cd units/chain && python3 -m pytest -q tests/ 2>&1 ); rc=$?
echo "[chain] rc=$rc :: $(echo "$out" | tail -1)" | tee -a "$LOG"; [ $rc -ne 0 ] && fail=1
for u in alpha beta; do
  out=$( cd "units/$u" && python3 check.py 2>&1 ); rc=$?
  echo "[$u] rc=$rc :: $out" | tee -a "$LOG"
  [ $rc -ne 0 ] && fail=1
done
echo "ALL_OK=$([ $fail -eq 0 ] && echo yes || echo no)" | tee -a "$LOG"", "timeout": 300}
